title: AJR 125 (2009-2010 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): requiring a photographic identification to vote, or register to vote, at the polls on election day (first consideration).
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Art. III, s. 1m (1) (proposed)
(quote) Analysis by the Legislative Reference Bureau This proposed constitutional amendment, proposed to the 2009 legislature on first consideration, provides that a qualified elector may not vote, or register to vote, at the polls on election day unless the elector presents a photographic identification issued by this state or by the federal government.
(section) Art. III, s. 1m (2) (proposed)
(quote) (2) After the date of ratification of this section, the legislature, by law, with the concurrence of two-thirds of all the members present, may exempt any class of electors from the requirements of subsection (1).
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
